props.heading: A Legacy of Feline Care
props.content:
ESTABLISHED 1993

Cats Luv Us Boarding Hotel was founded in 1993 with a simple but powerful vision: to create a boarding facility designed exclusively for cats. While most pet care businesses cater to dogs first and cats second, our founders recognized that cats have unique needs that deserve specialized attention.

Located at 27601 Forbes Rd in Laguna Niguel, our facility was purpose-built to provide a calm, dog-free environment where cats can feel safe, comfortable, and at home. Over the past three decades, we’ve cared for tens of thousands of feline guests, earning the trust of cat owners throughout South Orange County.

What started as a small boarding operation has grown into a full-service cat care facility offering boarding, grooming, daycare, and medication administration services. Through it all, our commitment to individualized, compassionate cat care has never wavered.

props.heading: The Cats Luv Us Difference
props.content:
WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT

We’re not just another pet boarding facility. We’re a cat-only sanctuary built around the unique behavioral and emotional needs of felines.

No dogs means no barking, no stress pheromones, and no fear. Our entire facility is designed for feline comfort, from the layout to the air filtration to the quiet environment.

Every member of our team is a cat lover first and a professional second. We understand cat behavior, recognize signs of stress, and know how to make even the shyest cats feel at ease.

Our boarding suites, grooming stations, and daycare areas are designed specifically for cats — with vertical spaces, hiding spots, perches, and climate-controlled rooms.

We administer prescribed medications, monitor health changes, and maintain detailed care logs. Our team includes staff with veterinary technician backgrounds.

props.heading: What We Stand For
props.content:
OUR CORE VALUES

Every decision we make starts with the well-being of the cats in our care. We treat each feline guest with the same tenderness and attention we’d give our own pets.

We believe in honest communication with pet parents. From pricing to care updates, you’ll always know exactly what’s happening with your cat.

We stay current with the latest in feline behavior science, nutrition, and grooming techniques. Our protocols evolve with the best practices in the industry.

We’re proud members of the Laguna Niguel community and active supporters of local cat rescue organizations and TNR programs throughout Orange County.
